title: Investigate recurring low-yield areas
question: Does a pattern recur in comparable corn seasons, and what should we inspect before changing practice?
effort: Start with a yield worksheet or map. Add matched seasons and field observations as they become available.
needs: Original yield records with their season, crop, units and coordinate system reviewed
No treatment, seed quote or current field polygon is required to save the investigation
produces: A versioned investigation and selected evidence
Yield-point quality checks and a coordinate-space preview
An editable checklist with optional owners and dates
A question that can later lead to a farmer-selected trial
limits: One map cannot establish persistence or cause. Points are not independent treatment replicates; their average is not an area-weighted field yield. Coordinates and units need review. Cross-season alignment and treatment-effect statistics are not automated.
